purpose: Discover and locally classify a balanced candidate portfolio of psychology interventions and intervention-relevant evidence across performance/work, personal, and health/clinical-adjacent CSI domains.

csi_domains.label: Performance, work motivation and workplace wellbeing
csi_domains.scope: Cognitive performance, motivation, engagement, wellbeing, resilience, workload, workflow, decision systems and human-AI work.

csi_domains.label: Personal adaptive cognition and wellbeing
csi_domains.scope: Self-directed cognition, learning, reasoning, habits, self-regulation, resilience, cognitive ageing and everyday functioning.

csi_domains.label: Health-related and clinical-adjacent support
csi_domains.scope: Psychological, cognitive, behavioural, rehabilitative, self-management and digital support relevant to symptoms, functioning, adherence and quality of life; not drug/device-only treatment evidence.

query_families.label: Workplace cognitive performance interventions
query_families.query: (workplace OR employee OR occupational OR "knowledge worker") AND ("cognitive performance" OR attention OR reasoning OR decision OR interruption) AND (intervention OR trial OR experiment OR training OR redesign)

query_families.label: Personal cognitive training and transfer
query_families.query: ("cognitive training" OR "working memory training" OR "executive function training") AND (healthy OR adult OR student OR older) AND (intervention OR trial OR randomized OR randomised) AND (transfer OR cognition OR performance)

query_families.label: Psychological and behavioural support for chronic pain
query_families.query: ("chronic pain" OR "primary pain") AND (psychological OR cognitive OR behavioural OR behavioral OR self-management) AND (intervention OR trial OR program OR programme)

query_families.label: Work motivation and engagement interventions
query_families.query: (workplace OR employee OR occupational) AND (motivation OR engagement OR "job crafting" OR autonomy OR "self determination") AND (intervention OR trial OR program OR programme)

query_families.label: Personal self-regulation and goal-management interventions
query_families.query: ("self-regulation" OR "self regulation" OR "implementation intention" OR "goal management training" OR habit) AND (intervention OR trial OR randomized OR randomised) AND (adult OR student OR community)

query_families.label: Anxiety and depression psychological support
query_families.query: (anxiety OR depression OR distress) AND (psychological OR cognitive OR behavioural OR behavioral OR digital) AND (intervention OR trial OR therapy OR self-management)

query_families.label: Workplace wellbeing, stress and resilience interventions
query_families.query: (workplace OR employee OR occupational) AND (wellbeing OR "well-being" OR stress OR burnout OR resilience OR recovery) AND (intervention OR trial OR program OR programme)

query_families.label: Metacognition and learning-strategy interventions
query_families.query: (metacognitive OR metacognition OR "learning strategy" OR "self-regulated learning") AND (intervention OR training OR randomized OR randomised) AND (learning OR memory OR education OR student)

query_families.label: Cognitive rehabilitation and neuropsychological support
query_families.query: ("cognitive rehabilitation" OR "cognitive remediation" OR "neuropsychological rehabilitation" OR "memory rehabilitation") AND (intervention OR trial OR program OR programme)

query_families.label: Human-AI cognition and work interventions
query_families.query: (workplace OR employee OR "knowledge work") AND ("artificial intelligence" OR "generative AI" OR chatbot OR automation) AND (cognition OR decision OR learning OR wellbeing OR workload) AND (experiment OR intervention OR evaluation)

query_families.label: Reasoning, problem-solving and decision interventions
query_families.query: ("reasoning training" OR "problem solving training" OR "critical thinking intervention" OR "decision making training") AND (trial OR intervention OR training OR experiment)

query_families.label: Health adherence and self-management interventions
query_families.query: (adherence OR "self-management" OR "self management" OR rehabilitation) AND (psychological OR cognitive OR behavioural OR behavioral OR motivational) AND (health OR illness OR patient) AND (intervention OR trial OR program OR programme)

query_families.label: Workflow, interruption and decision-system interventions
query_families.query: (workflow OR "work design" OR interruption OR "task switching" OR "decision support") AND (workplace OR employee OR organisation OR organization) AND (intervention OR redesign OR experiment OR trial)

query_families.label: Personal wellbeing, resilience and digital self-help interventions
query_families.query: (resilience OR wellbeing OR "well-being" OR stress OR "digital self-help" OR "digital self help") AND (cognitive OR psychological OR self-regulation OR behavioural OR behavioral) AND (intervention OR trial OR training) AND NOT workplace

query_families.label: Health-related functioning, fatigue and sleep support
query_families.query: (fatigue OR sleep OR "functional impairment" OR "quality of life") AND (psychological OR cognitive OR behavioural OR behavioral) AND (intervention OR trial OR self-management OR rehabilitation)

governance.clinical_boundary: Health-domain inclusion is for evidence discovery and intervention design. It does not authorise diagnosis, treatment recommendations, clinical claims or autonomous consequential use.
governance.notes: Outputs are discovery and abstract-screening candidates only. Abstract classification cannot establish efficacy, quality, RoB, certainty, transfer or recommendation authority.
